title: Strengthen PageSpeed evidence before remediation
proposedChange: Run three PageSpeed samples per locale/device instead of one.
Retry transient PSI/Lighthouse 5xx failures before marking a measurement error.
Use the median sample for performance, LCP, CLS and TBT decisions.
Require repeated evidence before promoting a finding to a remediation approval request.
reason: The latest run showed large lab variability and a transient TR mobile PSI 500. A single sample is not reliable enough to justify production code changes.
expectedImpact: Fewer false alarms and safer, evidence-based remediation decisions across EN/TR/ZH/RU.
risk: Longer workflow runtime and additional PageSpeed API usage. No production website mutation.
rollback: Revert the WebOps tooling PR and return to one sample per locale/device.
verification: Run the full EN/TR/ZH/RU x mobile/desktop matrix.
Confirm three samples are stored for each target when PSI succeeds.
Confirm Control Center reports median values and evidence count.
Confirm production writes and automatic merge remain disabled.
